step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents a microservices architecture for Rappi Pay. At the top level, users access the architecture through CloudFront, while partner systems connect via Direct Connect. In the middle compute tier, EC2, EKS, and Spot Fleet manage workloads (transitioning from EC2/kops to EKS and Spot instances). At the lower tier, developers interact with a custom Microservices API platform box, which interacts with persistent and messaging backend services including RDS, DocumentDB, ElastiCache, and MSK.
